load_evidence.user_measurement: User reported about0.2A previously and updated current reading to about0.7A; electronic clamp meter bandwidth, capture mode and measurement node not recorded
load_evidence.manufacturer_statement: Maximum 4G TX power may draw up to 2A transiently; recommend supply capability above2A and at least two220uF capacitors on VBAT
load_evidence.interpretation: 2A is a transient stress amplitude, not measured sustained voice-call consumption. Applied widths are assumptions; no board defect can be inferred solely from an assumed2ms profile
